faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Answers to the questions we hear most from homeowners.
faq.cardText: Call us and we'll gladly help you plan the right cleaning for your home.

items.question: What areas do you clean?
items.answer: ELQ Cleaning focuses on residential properties — kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, living areas, and other spaces throughout the home. Let us know your home's layout when you request an estimate.

items.question: How often can I schedule cleaning?
items.answer: You can schedule cleaning weekly, biweekly, or monthly, whichever best matches your household's routine.

items.question: Do I need to be home?
items.answer: It's entirely up to you. Some clients prefer to be home during the visit, while others arrange access so cleaning can happen while they're out. Let us know your preference when scheduling.

items.question: Can I request recurring service?
items.answer: Yes. Recurring service on a weekly, biweekly, or monthly basis is one of the most popular ways clients work with ELQ Cleaning.

items.question: How do I request an estimate?
items.answer: Call (480) 546-1725 or fill out the estimate form on this page with a few details about your home, and we'll follow up with you.

items.question: What should I do before my cleaning appointment?
items.answer: Tidying away personal items and valuables ahead of time helps our team focus fully on cleaning. If you have specific instructions for a particular room, let us know in advance.
